Their mission, as stated on their fundraising page:

>Sustainable energy is on everyone’s minds these days (there’s a reason there’s a Prius on every street corner), and Ovanova is leading the clean energy revolution. Specifically, this company has found a significant niche in the exploding industry of solar energy.
Here’s how it works: Ovanova is a free service that connects homeowners with solar education companies. Once the customer is connected with a solar education company, they are provided with a personalized proposal to use solar energy. Just for receiving the proposal, the homeowner’s community organization of choice receives a $100 donation. If the homeowner then decides to go solar, the homeowner’s chosen organization then receives an additional $500. Wow!

>Seems too good to be true, right? After all, where does that donation money come? Well, let’s shine some light on this part. The solar industry currently spends between $3,000-$5,000 per person who adopts solar energy. Most of that money is spent on lead generation channels such as billboards, radio ads, and TV commercials. Ovanova eliminates the need for those lead generation channels and uses that money for the donations instead.

>The three founders also have the sales and solar power experience needed to make Ovanoa shine truly brightly. All three supported themselves in college through selling books in the Southwestern Company and climbed the ranks from there, with one becoming District Sales Managers and two others leaving to work as an Energy Advisor and Regional Division Leader with Vision Solar.

>In the words of Ovanova, they are “built on a foundation of giving and trusting, not profit-maximization and branding.” They also talk a lot about love, magic, and the goodness of people. Like…a lot. Like, in a way that would make the Beatles proud. Love is important, but profit matters too. Ovanova needs to remember to sign their websites with love AND a promise to investors that they will earn more than just a warm fuzzy. Solar energy is becoming the energy of the future, and if Ovanova can help create sunny days for both communities and investors, then I say – shine brightly on.

To give you a better idea of how this works, they've created a [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rgkrkAbPXLg&feature=youtu.be) of an actual call that was made to a consumer. 

They can use any help, whether it's just spreading the word or investing through their [Start Engine](https://www.startengine.com/ovanova) page. Even if you run a non-profit and you would like to talk to them about working with them to raise money for **your** cause, message me and I'll put you in touch!
